findings.summary: list() trusts any cached row that has a non-empty `terminal`, but rebuild_status can write a row with state="running" AND terminal set (result.json already written while the unit is still active); such a row is then never recomputed, so development_list can keep reporting a dead development as running until some other call rebuilds the cache.

The dispatch context labels a3398dbe… as work_head_commit, while the committed implement handoff records work_head_commit=ed4548e651d6cbcfb8076bc5e7b8771ae40762dc with a3398dbe… stacked on top as the materialization commit; the product change under review is ed4548e6…, and the two identities should not be conflated in downstream audit.
